title: 汉尘：腐草为萤
description:
Eighty rounds of super long simulated survival game, the four seasons rotate, we will spend 20 years in the game.· After the summer, harvest in autumn and hide in winter, try to live in the last years of the Eastern Han Dynasty more than 1,800 years ago.

The unique imitation of ancient ink painting style, trying to restore the historical background of the late Eastern Han Dynasty SIM simulation operation survival, once strong Eastern Han Dynasty is about to "unite for a long time will be divided", each hard "we", are also struggling to find the meaning of survival.·有志者，事竟成——《后汉书》
In order to survive, we will try everything. Hunting, fishing, herding, mining, farming, gathering and even touching corpses, stealing.

Think carefully about every attempt or choice you make, and you may become a herdsman, woodworker, blacksmith, cook, doctor, hermit, merchant, thief, soldier in the late Eastern Han Dynasty, or even inadvertently change the fate of others, becoming a participant and witness to the miracle of the troubled times.The game will be based on player attributes and trigger events, and eventually set up dozens or even hundreds of different wonderful endings.

With the help of wisdom and courage, can you survive the chaotic Little Ice Age full of "war", "famine", "flood", "earthquake", "cold wave", "plague" and so on, and whether at the end of the moment, confirmed the inner choice of survival?

Try to live together.

description_short: “The last day of Han dynasty”It is a survival simulation business game based on the background of the end of the Han Dynasty in China. From the perspective of ordinary people, you can spend a difficult but warm time, and keep warm together with the characters you know in the troubled times.
